segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let alertSuppressionKey = "AlertSuppression" let defaults = UserDefaults.standard if defaults.bool(forKey: alertSuppressionKey) { print("Alert suppressed") } else { let anAlert = NSAlert() anAlert.messageText = "Message text." anAlert.informativeText = "Informative Text." anAlert.showsSuppressionButton = true anAlert.runModal() if let suppressionButton = anAlert.suppressionButton, suppressionButton.state == .on { defaults.set(true, forKey: alertSuppressionKey) } } ```
